company.name: Voicegem
company.shortDescription: Voicegem is a web and iOS based voice messaging platform.
company.description: Voicegem is a web and iOS app offering an easy way to send voice messages to anyone. Users of Voicegem are provided with the facility to record long messages, and send it to anyone through an email or Facebook message. The recipients (friends or family) of the Voicegem messages can listen and reply to voice messages without installing or signing up with any platform.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows users to send voice messages via email or Facebook, providing an alternative to phone calls for asynchronous communication.
